title: A review of defatting processes using sustainable solvents: parallels between seed and fish oil sources
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2224-2236
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00702J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eugenia Mazzara, Brijesh K. Tiwari
Conventional defatting for oilseed and fish biomasses is mainly based on petrochemical solvents like hexane. Alternative options such as natural deep eutectic solvents and vegetable oils can enhance safety and sustainability in oil removal processes.
